feeds.title: Homeschool Dad
feeds.description: My wife and I are natives of Long Island, New York, and Central Massachusetts, graduates of Boston College and UPenn, and have both worked in finance/Wall Street for 15+ years - our entire careers. Although now I primarily teach accelerated math and advise parents on how to educate their children.

feeds.title: Classical Home School Dad
feeds.description: Classical Home School Dad is a blog written by a dad to share light on homeschooling from a father's point of view.

feeds.title: Fouled Up Life » Homeschool
feeds.description: Read the articles on homeschooling. We are a blended family of four living in the Pacific Northwest. For now, we split our time between two cities, a home and a boat, between life on the water and life on the sea. Our goal is to someday sail around the world. I started Fouled Up Life in 2020 primarily to blog about sailing the Pacific Northwest, but it is evolving to become more of - for lack of a better phrase - a blog about how I am learning how to live a better life.

feeds.title: Dadcarestoo
feeds.description: DadCaresToo is a resource about homeschooling from the perspective of me, a father who really does care! After Sabrina, my wife told me she wanted to homeschool our youngest son, I didn't think much about it. So I started doing research myself and that's when I started to think maybe we should set up a resource ourselves to share our journey and what we learned along the way.

feeds.title: Catholic Homeschool Dad Blog
feeds.description: Explore Catholic Dad stories, spiritual direction, tips, and resources I have picked up along the way. I am a Husband, Father and Homeschool Parent of Four Children. I taught several years of theology at the college and high school levels and woked in campus and parish ministry.
